summary: Verified the two new GRID VJ features + regressions at '/'. FEATURE 1 (Font drag&drop): uploaded /usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf via set_input_files on grid-font-input; document.fonts contains {family: 'LiberationSans Bold', status: 'loaded'}, the family is appended to grid-font-select options ['Archivo Black','Anton','Bebas Neue','Unbounded','Syne','Space Grotesk','LiberationSans Bold'] and becomes the active selection (trigger text = 'LiberationSans Bold'; config.font = 'LiberationSans Bold'), and stage text elements report computed fontFamily = '"LiberationSans Bold", sans-serif'. FEATURE 2 (Pop-out): opened a second tab to `${origin}/output` after upload; grid-stage renders, /output document.fonts registers two 'LiberationSans Bold' FontFace entries (from broadcast) with status loaded, and /output text spans use the same fontFamily. FEATURE 3 (Audio panel): granted microphone permission, clicked grid-mic-button — the 'Analisi audio' panel appears with all 10 testids (grid-level-bass/mid/high, grid-int-bass/mid/high, grid-band-bass/mid/high, grid-sens-slider). Meter widths are percentages (e.g. bass 9.94% → 28.93% after intensity increase). Clicking grid-band-mid highlights it (ring-emerald + ▶ marker in text '▶ Medi'). ArrowRight x8 on grid-int-bass updates label from 'Bassi intensità 1.0x' → 'Bassi intensità 1.8x' (mid stays at 1.0x, confirming per-band state). Mic OFF removes the panel. No console/page errors throughout. REGRESSIONS: grid-wrap-toggle absent (OK), mode-kinetic/mode-grid absent (OK), grid-dynamic-toggle/color1/color2/swap-colors/play/tap/fullscreen/popout/restructure all present. Note: there is a single grid-play-button (toggles Play/Stop) — no separate grid-stop-button, which matches earlier iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: onFonts derives family via /[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]/g → 'LiberationSans-Bold.ttf' becomes 'LiberationSans Bold' (hyphen stripped). Works but might collide across variants (Bold/Regular). Consider preserving hyphens or appending a hash suffix.

Fonts broadcast is done from a useEffect on customFonts. If the pop-out is opened AFTER upload, it still receives fonts because studio also re-broadcasts on scene/lightConfig/clips change (verified). Consider having /output request the current font list on mount to avoid relying on later broadcasts.
seed_data_creation: Used system font /usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf as the drag&drop payload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All targeted features + regressions verified via live DOM (document.fonts inspection, getComputedStyle fontFamily on stage spans, inline width percentages on level meters, class/text of band buttons, label text for intensity sliders). Pop-out cross-tab font propagation confirmed with a real .ttf.
